images.title: Adding years changes the ratio
images.purpose: Compares Neelima's and her mother's ages now (3 and 30) and 9 years later (12 and 39) to show the ratio changes.
images.composition: Two pairs of vertical bars side by side, before on the left and after on the right, drawn to one scale on a common baseline. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Left pair: a teal (#0072B2) bar 3 units tall labelled '3' and an amber (#E69F00) bar 30 units tall labelled '30'; under the pair the label 'now 1 : 10'. Right pair: a teal bar 12 units tall labelled '12' and an amber bar 39 units tall labelled '39'; in each right bar the top 9 units are reddish purple (#CC79A7) to show the added years. Under the right pair the label 'later 4 : 13'. A small key under the frame: teal square 'Neelima', amber square 'mother'. Exactly 4 bars, 2 purple top segments of equal height.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Adding the same number to both ages changes their ratio.
images.description: Compares Neelima's and her mother's ages now (3 and 30) and 9 years later (12 and 39) to show the ratio changes.

image_decisions.why: The equal purple segments make it visible that both ages grow by adding, which is why the ratio is not kept.
